## Type of change

- [ ] Editorial / non-normative (typo, clarification, docs, examples)
- [ ] Backward-compatible addition (MINOR)
- [ ] Normative or breaking change (MAJOR) — requires an ADR in `docs/adr/` and maintainer consensus (GOVERNANCE.md §4–§5)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Any change to normative requirements or signing/verification semantics is recorded in an ADR
- [ ] No change makes VRP depend on a central issuer, registry, or gatekeeper (ADR 0002)
- [ ] Relative links resolve and new/changed JSON validates against its schema
